# Security Policy

The authoritative security policy is the repository-root [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md).
This file exists so GitHub community insights and agents that look under `.github/`
find the same reporting path.

## Reporting a Vulnerability

**Do not open a public GitHub issue for security vulnerabilities.**

1. Follow the process in the root [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md).
2. Prefer GitHub private vulnerability reporting for this repository:
   https://github.com/SafetyMP/Healthcare-Data-Exchange/security/advisories/new

Include impact, reproduction steps, and affected paths (gateway, OPAL, consent-service, and so on) when it is safe to do so.
